about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples: 'weaker colour grade' with nothing to weaken must answer a typed noop, never a plain ok (night-1 row 471, COV-weaker-at-zero). Each example runs against the phase 3 _MovesFixture (tests/test_moves.py: P6281348.ORF.xmp, no colour-balance-rgb history yet -- every chroma row starts at its declared neutral, 0%). Run by tests/intent/test_weaker_grade_noop_intent.py. Two oracles per example: the phrase's own top-level `noop` field (scouter/core/moves.py:say, scouter/types.py:SayResult) and the FakeBridge's own recorded `darkroom.action` call count (an honest noop sends nothing).
subject: scouter/core/moves.py:say (the colorbalancergb {shadows,midtones,highlights}_chroma moves of the weaker_grade phrase)

examples.source: night-1 gauntlet triage row 471 (COV-weaker-at-zero, cov-phrase-weaker_grade-olympus-bare): every chroma move '+0% (0% -> 0%)', history_end 65 -> 65 -- the recorded run (5501801) answered ok with noop false; the fix types it noop (row-432 shape) instead

control example: the same phrase, with something to weaken (the gauntlet fix's own graded precondition, tests/gauntlet/layers/coverage.py:_graded_precondition), must not be flattened to a noop just because the field now exists
